name: red-handed
description: Audit what a coding agent actually did against what it said it did, from the session transcript and the repository's git state.

plugins.name: red-handed
plugins.description: Your agent said the tests pass. This checks that a test actually ran. Installing turns on two hooks: one keeps test results from being cut out of the record, one audits each session against git as it ends. Local files only, no model calls, no telemetry. Uninstalling removes both hooks.
